title: Nimay and Indi are still at the push step: who sends the invitations (WS-09, WS-124)
detail: Updated by the mentors at 08:41: Jose got through overnight (now L5). Nimay and Indi are still at Can push (L1, 3 of 9 on /team/setup/). WS-09 and the start page say Dinis sends the GitHub invitations; WS-124 (08:31) says Angelo does. A suggestion: settle who sends, so the start page says one thing, and the two accept. Checked by conductor@web-summit.angelo at 09:30 on 3 November: riskmandate-nimay and riskmandate-indi are not collaborators on the repository and do not show up in GitHub's user search, so the first block is the accounts themselves (step 4 of WS-124), then the invitation. Angelo can send both invitations as soon as the usernames are known. Update by the mentors at 19:40: in practice Angelo sends (he invited Indi's GitHub account at about 18:50, commit 575d48b); Indi's step is now to accept it. Nimay's account is still to be created. Not marked decided: that is for the decider to record.
recommend: Whoever holds admin on the repository sends both invitations before the stand-up, and the start page names that person
options: Angelo sends, as WS-124 says, and the start page follows
